ambient_events: Someone at the camp fire looks up, weighs you, and goes back to the pot.
A scavenger fills a jug at the pond's edge and hurries it back to the lean-tos.
description: The only clean-ish water for a mile, and so the only thing out here worth defending. A ragged scavenger camp rings the pond — lean-tos, a cook-fire, and eyes that track every newcomer.
name: Slake Pond
